items.title: Insani insulin banane ke paanch qadam (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the steps of making insulin (PDF 165-166).

items: Do genes ki tayyari: kyunke insulin ki do alag zanjeerein hain, do DNA silsile banaye jate hain, aik chain A aur aik chain B ke liye.

Recombinant plasmids banana: chain A ka DNA plasmids ke aik set mein aur chain B ka doosre mein dala jata, aksar lacZ jaise bacterial gene ke saath taa ke bacteria bairooni DNA pehchan kar zahir karein.
Host cells ki transformation: plasmids Escherichia coli ke do alag cultures mein dale jate; culture 1 chain A aur culture 2 chain B banata hai.
Fermentation aur protein expression: bacteria bare sanati bioreactors mein ugaye jate aur barhte hue insani DNA parh kar insulin ki zanjeerein bari miqdar mein banate hain.

Nikalna aur kimiyai jor: bacteria jama kar ke zanjeerein nikali aur saaf ki jati hain; chain A aur chain B mila kar khaas amino acids ke darmiyan disulfide (sulphur se sulphur) bonds se jorri jati hain.

blocks.alt: Do mutawazi qataarein. Masnooi gene A aur masnooi gene B har aik lacZ ke saath plasmid mein, phir apne E. coli culture mein, phir bioreactor mein, jis se saaf chain A aur chain B milti hain. Zanjeerein mila kar disulfide pulon se jorri jati aur insani insulin banti hai. Dabba paanch qadam ginwata hai.
blocks.caption: Insani insulin banane ke paanch qadam (Figure 20.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Insulin ki do polypeptide zanjeerein hain, is liye do DNA silsile banaye jate hain, aik chain A aur aik chain B ke liye. Har aik ko apne plasmids ke set mein dala jata hai, aksar lacZ jaise bacterial gene ke saath taa ke bacteria use pehchan kar zahir karein. Plasmids Escherichia coli ke do alag cultures mein dale jate hain, aik chain A aur doosra chain B banata hai. Bacteria bare sanati bioreactors mein ugaye jate aur barhte hue zanjeerein banate hain. Phir zanjeerein nikal kar saaf, mila kar khaas amino acids ke darmiyan disulfide (sulphur se sulphur) bonds se jorri jati hain, aur pancreas jaisi kaam karne wali insani insulin banti hai.

blocks.text: Yeh aakhri qadam kaam karne wali, teen jihati (three-dimensional) insani insulin molecule deta hai jo sehatmand insani pancreas jaisi hai.

blocks.prompt: Chain A aur B do alag cultures mein kyun banti hain?
blocks.explanation: Har culture mein sirf aik gene wale plasmids hain, is liye woh sirf aik zanjeer bari miqdar mein banata hai; saaf zanjeerein phir laboratory mein disulfide bonds se jorri jati hain.

items: Do masnooi genes, plasmids ke do set, E. coli ke do cultures.
Bioreactors zanjeerein banate; saaf kar ke disulfide bonds se jorri jati hain.
